_authority: CONVENIENCE INDEX, NEVER THE AUTHORITY. Every value here is recomputable from the files under results/. A consumer that trusts this file over those files has moved the trust boundary to whoever last edited this file.

windows.grandfathered: Predates §5.2's window_id convention and the commit-reveal protocol entirely. Directory name is a date, not YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMZ, and is deliberately not renamed. Both sides published counts directly; MCPShip published blind, StillOS did not, and that asymmetry is recorded rather than smoothed over.
windows.state_not_derived_from_tree: No commitment or reveal artifacts exist under this window, so its state cannot be recomputed from results/. Value carried verbatim from the published index. Applies to pre-commit-reveal windows only; any window with artifacts is derived.

windows.participant_set_source: explicit --participants override, supplied by the publisher
